verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hosted tracing and evaluation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a REST Service API with a call-query endpoint, an OpenAPI spec, and OTel trace import, but no documented bulk export of all data in open formats. Those are developer building blocks for reading data and ingest-side interoperability, not an export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
